1 2 3On the start screen: pick green 6, red 6 or yellow 9 (or click the faint numbers) Click an envelopeOpens it (number keys open the 1st, 2nd, 3rd... envelope on screen) Clicker forwardMingus up → count-off and claps → back to the envelopes Clicker backClose the rhythm without Mingus (same as the faint Skip or S) M or Mingus buttonMingus up, then play; after he plays, he flies up and plays again Click MingusWhile he's playing: stop and reset to just before playback U / UndoPut back the last envelope used R / ResetPut back every envelope in the set H / house iconBack to the start screen to pick a different set FFull screen on or off
